name: smartmontools
description: Utilities (smartctl, smartd) for monitoring and controlling the Self-Monitoring, Analysis, and Reporting Technology (S.M.A.R.T.) system built into most modern ATA/SCSI/NVMe hard drives and SSDs.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
